description: This file defines the 'Topic' class within the Opencart admin event controller namespace. It contains methods to handle adding, editing, and deleting topics by creating corresponding tasks to be processed, and interacts with the 'setting/task' model to enqueue these tasks.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller class for handling topic-related events such as add, edit, and delete, by creating tasks for later processing.

methods.name: addTopic
methods.description: Creates a task to generate new topic data when a topic is added.

methods.name: editTopic
methods.description: Creates a task to update topic data when a topic is edited.

methods.name: deleteTopic
methods.description: Creates a task to delete topic data when a topic is deleted.
